description: Qualitative Figures Metadata for KITTI Split T (Task T16)
zero_touch_verification: Strictly read-only images and static predictions parquet (Decision D90)

figures.title: (a) Side Aspect Angle Effect (D19)
figures.description: Side aspect angle: Width dilates to vehicle length; Zw under-predicts; Residual model compensates.

figures.title: (b) Near Physical 3D Bias (Pattern 111, D21/D92)
figures.description: Near physical bias: Negative bias in Zd from 3D box center vs nearest surface; Residual eliminates offset.

figures.title: (c) Boundary Truncation & Adaptive CQR (D84/D91)
figures.description: Boundary truncation: Bottom edge contact loses height/ground cues; adaptive CQR expands interval to safely contain target.

figures.title: (d) Robust Fallback on Pattern 000 (D74)
figures.description: Fallback Pattern 000: All geometric cues invalid; direct baseline model provides anchor; CQR interval covers target.

figures.title: (e) Boundary Extrapolation Failure (Rank 1 Manifest)
figures.description: Corner truncation: vehicle truncated at image boundary; direct baseline model suffers extrapolation error (observational hypothesis).

figures.title: (f) Nominal Success: Near-Mid Range
figures.description: Nominal Success: Representative target from frozen manifest; sharp point estimate and tight CQR interval.

figures.title: (g) Nominal Success: Mid Range
figures.description: Nominal Success: Representative target from frozen manifest; sharp point estimate and tight CQR interval.

figures.title: (h) KITTI Hard Difficulty Target
